question: Whom did the lotus-born creator behold upon reaching the milk ocean's shore?
premises: The lotus-born creator saw a deity.
Vāsudeva is the teacher of the world.
inference: At the shore, the creator beheld Vāsudeva, the lotus-eyed teacher of the world.
plain_english: He saw the lotus-eyed Vāsudeva, the teacher of the world.
